{{Quote|Greetings, Deputy Strey. DV-9 requesting access to raw data files. I have three researchers from offplanet with me.''"<br />"''Voice authorization confirmed. Go ahead.|DV-9 and Strey|<ref name="GoF">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Hunger]]''</ref>}}
Deputy '''Strey''' was an Imperial clerk at the [[Galactic Research Academy]] on [[Koaan]]. He worked in the underground processing facility at the facility, and a consequence, he looked pale and sickly from too much time indoors. He had a sour demeanor.

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Strey gave permission for [[DV-9]], a research assistant droid at the facility, to bring [[Mammon Hoole]] and his two wards into the facility. While they were there, he was shot by a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], including [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]], who were breaking into the facility to steal planetary data. The [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] was set to stun, knocking out Strey, and he only recovered after Okeefe, Hoole and all their companions had escaped the facility.
